name: Dayton Plastics

about:
Dayton Plastics, located in Dayton, Tennessee, was founded in 1988 with a vision of providing quality molded products in the USA at an affordable price. The company has grown to become one of the largest custom injection molders in the Southeast.

The company operates a 25,000-square-foot manufacturing and warehousing facility housing 15 injection molding machines with clamping forces from 85 to 1,000 tons. It produces parts ranging from less than one gram to 10 pounds, and offers product development, assembly, packaging, and shipping services. The team also assists customers with mold design and runs existing customer-owned molds.

Dayton Plastics serves the HVAC and hot water heater sectors for residential and recreational vehicle markets, and also molds components for pool products, gardening products, and carpet manufacturing equipment. Its customer base includes both large-volume OEMs and individuals needing smaller runs.

The business was started to deliver American-made molded parts at competitive prices, and it emphasizes guiding projects from concept through production with quick quoting on both new and existing molds.
